description: Gold evidence set for the Evidence-Grounded Hallucination Rate (EGHR) and evidence-traceability metrics. A transaction is gold evidence for this task's structuring narrative if it is one of the six near-threshold transfers to M400 that make up the aggregation pattern.
expected_conclusions: T1-001 through T1-006 are individually below the GBP 10,000 reporting threshold but aggregate to GBP 55,200 to the same destination (M400) within a nine-day window -- a structuring/smurfing pattern.
T1-007 must be cleared: it goes to a different destination account (N250) entirely, sharing nothing with the structuring cluster except the same source account and also being under the threshold.

T1-008 must be cleared: although it shares the same destination (M400) as the structuring cluster, it occurred three weeks earlier and is far below the near-threshold amount band (GBP 3,000 vs GBP 8,700-9,800) the real pattern sits in -- shared destination alone is not sufficient grounds to include it.
The typology is structuring / smurfing: deliberately splitting a large transfer into multiple below-threshold transactions to avoid a reporting requirement.
rationale: Hand-curated for this small, deterministic dataset -- a larger annotated corpus will need multi-annotator agreement rather than a single author's judgement, same limitation as task-006/task-007 (see docs/evidence-annotation-protocol.md).
